interpretation_requiring_human_review.note: Passing mechanical validation does NOT confirm substantive policy coding. Human review is required for all AI proposals below.

items.detail: Confirm D5=3 (vs 2) after excluding Turnitin detection disablement and external paid-tool differences as standalone safeguard gaps.
Confirm D2=2 grounded in authorship/integrity verification and assessment appeal authorities (N002, N141) alongside undocumented Unit Coordinator permission criteria (N133, N136).
Confirm D3=2 (distinguishing N133/N136 approved-assessment 'must' from N134/A005 general 'recommended' scopes).

Obtain 'Information and Communication Technology (ICT) Appropriate Use Procedures' (referenced by operative N005 p.218 L010-L011) and 'Disclosure of Information and Proxy Authorisation Form' (N149) to resolve Critical gap: Uncertain vs Yes or No (additional evidence may demonstrate adequate protection).
Confirm Mode=Prescribing (vs None) since N149/N002/N141 supply prescriptive third-party disclosure and advocacy rules without delegating AI-agent SSO recognition to a named role.

Obtain WAUSDA / Retention and Disposal Authorities, Disposal of Information guide (N011 3.8(c)), N001 Section 6 AI supporting procedures, PIA Checklist, and Student Privacy Collection Notice to resolve Critical gap: Uncertain vs Yes or No (additional evidence may demonstrate adequate protection).
Confirm whether N150 PC12 (2.6.1 prior consent for learning analytics) or N016 Appendix A (general educational service collection) controls when an AI learning assistant is voluntary within a unit.
